title: LVMH posts surprise drop in first-quarter sales as luxury demand weakens
summary: LVMH reported a worse than expected decline in first-quarter sales, with revenue falling across its key fashion and leather goods division as well as wines and spirits. The disappointing results raise fresh concerns about the luxury sector's resilience amid persistent inflation and high interest rates.
